notes.title: Demo update v1.0.0c
notes.notes: [p]A minor demo update to fix some stuff. Version [b]1.0.0c[/b] changes the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] challenge "Laser Run I" is now working - previously players could not start this challenge due to some missing content in demo[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tweak:[/b] reduced Infernal Skeleton Max HP from 100 to 75 - they can appear on first level and were a bit too difficult for new players[/p][/*][*][p][b]Content:[/b] added "Liquid Speed" Artifact to the content available in demo[/p][/*][/list]
